On 15 October 1991 the Fly's Eye cosmic-ray detector in Utah recorded a single subatomic particle with an energy of about 3.2 x 10^20 electron-volts: roughly a thrown baseball's worth of energy packed into one particle, and some 40 million times the energy of the highest-energy protons made in any Earth accelerator. In 2021 the Telescope Array saw a second, the Amaterasu particle (2.4 x 10^20 eV), apparently from the empty Local Void, again with no matching source. Some researchers say these events might follow physics unknown to science. Nobody knows what the particle was or where it came from.

thread.text: In 1991 one subatomic particle hit Utah with the energy of a thrown baseball. Nothing in our galaxy could have made it, and it carried more energy than rays from other galaxies should have. What was it? 👇

Utah physics: "you trace its trajectory to its source and there's nothing high energy enough to have produced it." https://www.physics.utah.edu/news/telescope-array-detects-second-highest-energy-cosmic-ray-ever

~3.2 x 10^20 eV: about 40 million times the best protons from Earth accelerators. A second event, Amaterasu (2021), seems to come from the empty Local Void. Origin of both unknown. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oh-My-God_particle

thread.text:
Dec 1900: a lighthouse off Scotland went dark. When the relief keeper landed, the gate was shut, the clock had stopped, and all 3 keepers were gone. One man's coat was still hanging inside.

One giant wave, or a gale off the cliffs? 👇

What the relief keeper wrote (28 Dec 1900): McArthur "has his wearing coat left behind him which shows... that he went out in shirt sleeves." The lamp was cleaned, the fountain full. Source: Northern Lighthouse Board archive https://www.nlb.org.uk/history/flannan-isles

Official report (Supt. Muirhead, Jan 1901): a rope box 110 ft above the sea was torn away, so "an unexpectedly large roller" likely swept them off. No bodies were found. The 'storm log' entries are a later fabrication. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flannan_Isles_Lighthouse

thread.text: 1921: a schooner runs aground with sails set and only three cats aboard. The whole crew was gone, and nobody ever found out why. #GhostShip
The Carroll A. Deering was found stranded on Diamond Shoals in Jan 1921: lifeboats, logbook and navigation gear gone. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carroll_A._Deering
Five government departments investigated; the case closed without an official finding. Source: https://nationalcoastguardmuseum.org/articles/ghostship-carroll-a-deering

thread.text: 1970, Norway: a woman found burned in a lonely valley. Every label on her things had been removed. 50+ years later, nobody knows who she was. #IsdalWoman
Her suitcases at Bergen station held wigs, plain-glass spectacles, foreign money and a coded notepad; she had used at least eight false names. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isdal_Woman
Police ruled suicide, but even then doubts were raised, and her identity is still unknown. Source: https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-39369429

thread.text: 1955: a ship that could not sink was found drifting with all 25 people gone, a doctor's bag and bloody bandages on deck. #Joyita #GhostShip
MV Joyita left Samoa in October 1955 for a two-day trip. Five weeks later she was found 600 miles off course, nobody aboard, all three liferafts gone. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MV_Joyita
Her radio was tuned to the distress channel, but a wire was broken. The inquiry called her fate inexplicable on the evidence. Source: https://www.matauala.org.nz/joyita-unsolved-mystery

thread.text: 1978: a young pilot radios that something is hovering over his plane. "It's not an aircraft." Then 17 seconds of metallic noise, and silence. #Valentich

Frederick Valentich, 20, was flying a Cessna over Bass Strait on 21 Oct 1978. Controllers knew of no other traffic. Neither he nor his plane was ever found. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disappearance_of_Frederick_Valentich

One researcher argues he became disoriented and saw his own lights reflected; Australian officials never determined the cause. Source: https://skepticalinquirer.org/2013/11/the-valentich-disappearance-another-ufo-cold-case-solved/

thread.text: In 1909 a liner with 211 people blinked her name to a passing ship and sailed over the horizon. No wreck has ever been found. #SSWaratah

SS Waratah left Durban for Cape Town in July 1909 with 211 people and no radio. A storm hit, and months of searching across thousands of miles found neither bodies nor debris. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SS_Waratah
The inquiry ruled she foundered in the storm, but no physical proof ever emerged. Source: https://www.slsa.sa.gov.au/australias-titanic-sinking-of-ss-waratah

thread.text: A fire burned a woman to ash in her armchair in 1951. The newspapers beside her never scorched. #MaryReeser #Unsolved

In July 1951 in St. Petersburg, Florida, Mary Reeser's landlady found the doorknob warm. Inside, little remained of Mary but part of her left foot, still in its slipper. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_of_Mary_Reeser

The FBI concluded she fell asleep smoking and burned like a candle (the wick effect). Bone expert Wilton Krogman still doubted a body could burn that completely. FBI file: https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/fbifiles/paranormal/shc.pdf

text: One snowy night in 1855, something walked straight over people's houses in Devon and left a trail of hoofprints. Nobody ever found what. #DevilsFootprints

thread.text: One snowy night in 1855, something walked straight over people's houses in Devon and left a trail of hoofprints. Nobody ever found what. #DevilsFootprints

After heavy snow on the night of 8-9 Feb 1855, hoof-like prints about 4 inches long appeared across Devon, reported from 30+ places, over roofs and high walls. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devil%27s_Footprints

Badgers, wood mice, a runaway balloon trailing shackles: researcher Mike Dash concluded no single cause explains every mark and 'the mystery remains'. Source: https://www.bbc.co.uk/devon/discovering/legends/devil_footprints.shtml

thread.text: A Kerala village has more than 400 pairs of twins, five times India's rate. Scientists still can't say why. #Kodinhi #Kerala

Kodinhi in Kerala's Malappuram district has more than 400 pairs of twins among about 2,000 families, roughly 45 per 1,000 births vs about 9 across India. Source: https://www.dw.com/en/scientists-puzzled-by-twin-births-boom-in-indian-village/a-43623136
A 2016 DNA study by scientists from India, Germany and the UK took samples in the village and found no clear answer. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kodinhi

thread.text: For 72 seconds in 1977, something out there seemed to call Earth. Then it fell silent forever. #WowSignal #SETI

On 15 Aug 1977 Ohio State's Big Ear telescope logged a 72-second burst about 30 times stronger than the background. Volunteer Jerry Ehman circled 6EQUJ5 on the printout and wrote 'Wow!'. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wow!_signal
Big Ear's second feed horn should have heard it minutes later. It heard nothing, and decades of searches never found it again. Ehman's own 20-year report: http://www.bigear.org/wow20th.htm

thread.text:
In 1908 something exploded over Siberia and flattened 80 million trees.

When scientists finally got there, there was no crater.

What blew up over Tunguska? #Tunguska

The blast hit at about 7:14 am on 30 June 1908, 5-10 km above the ground. Around 2,000 km² of forest went down, every tree pointing away from the centre. Source: Britannica https://www.britannica.com/event/Tunguska-event

Leonid Kulik didn't reach the site until 1927. He expected a giant meteorite. Instead: standing, stripped 'telegraph pole' trees at the epicentre and no crater at all. Source: NASA History https://www.nasa.gov/history/115-years-ago-the-tunguska-asteroid-impact-event/

text: A Mont Blanc glacier keeps giving back an Indian plane that crashed in 1966. #AirIndia #MontBlanc

thread.text: A Mont Blanc glacier keeps giving back an Indian plane that crashed in 1966. #AirIndia #MontBlanc

Air India Flight 101 hit Mont Blanc on 24 January 1966; all 117 aboard died, including Homi Bhabha. The investigation found the crew believed they had passed the summit and kept descending. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_India_Flight_101
In August 2012 a rescue worker found a jute diplomatic bag on the Bossons glacier; its 1966 newspapers were still readable. Source: https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-19419781

text: One night in 1986, a lake in Cameroon breathed out an invisible gas, and 1,746 people never woke up. #LakeNyos #TrueStory

thread.text: One night in 1986, a lake in Cameroon breathed out an invisible gas, and 1,746 people never woke up. #LakeNyos #TrueStory

Lake Nyos sits in an old volcano. CO2 from deep hot rock seeps into its cold bottom water. On 21 Aug 1986 the lake overturned and the gas flowed down the valleys, killing 1,746 people and about 3,500 cattle. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lake_Nyos_disaster
Since 2001, pipes have been venting the gas from the lake bottom slowly, because the springs keep refilling it. Source: Kling et al. 2005, PNAS https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC1242283

thread.text: A note from 129 lost Arctic explorers says all is well. Its margin says otherwise. #FranklinExpedition #ArcticHistory

The Victory Point note, found in 1859: the 1847 message said all well; the margin added in April 1848 said Franklin was dead and 105 men were starting south. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franklin%27s_lost_expedition

Inuit testimony recorded by John Rae in 1854 described starving men who fell and died as they walked. Erebus was found in 2014, Terror in 2016. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Rae_(explorer)

thread.text: In 1944, gold bars and burning debris rained down on Bombay when a munitions ship blew up in the harbour. #Mumbai #IndianHistory

The Fort Stikine carried 1,395 tons of explosives, cotton bales, oil and 31 crates of gold. Her captain called the cargo "just about everything that will either burn or blow up." Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1944_Bombay_explosion

About 800 people died, 231 of them from the dock services and fire brigade. April 14 is still observed as Fire Brigade Day in Mumbai. Source: https://scroll.in/article/661674/the-day-it-rained-gold-and-death-in-bombay-rare-footage-of-the-1944-dock-explosion

thread.text: Two royal boys were locked in the Tower of London in 1483, and nobody ever saw them again. #history #toweroflondon

In 1674, workmen digging under a staircase near the White Tower found a wooden box holding two small skeletons. Charles II had them buried in Westminster Abbey. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Princes_in_the_Tower
The bones were examined in 1933 but have never been DNA tested, so nobody can prove they are the princes. Suspects named by historians include Richard III, Henry VII and the Duke of Buckingham.
